authority: R-167 v1.6 is an additive T0 theorem with two deliberately separate conclusions. First, the exact modular right-context estimate upgrades the selected EXP-000781 tangent-net result from single cyclic characters to every fixed finite raw configuration-orbit word moment and Gram block, hence to pointed finite-core Fell/GNS convergence on the algebraic raw orbit-word span. Second, the exact zero-source finite periodic Hamiltonians define one beta- and state-independent universal L1-orbit-smear C-star carrier with a point-norm continuous time-shift group. The EXP-000789 zero-source approximate broken doublets have two distinct weak-star cluster states on that carrier, and both are ground states for its common shift. The carrier is categorical rather than quasi-local: it proves no all-exhaustion spatial Cauchy, no inductive raw oscillator algebra, no canonical momentum or polynomial local generator, no identification with the fixed-beta OS phase envelopes, and no broken-sector GNS gap.

selected_tangent_raw_word_completion.input: Fix beta>0 and the already registered EXP-000781 plus/minus source tangent diagonal net. R-167 v1.5 supplies fixed-band word-kernel convergence and the uniform cyclic Fejer error for every raw rational configuration character.
selected_tangent_raw_word_completion.right_context: In the support-reduced faithful beta-KMS standard form with sigma_s=alpha_(-beta hbar s), every entire right context C obeys YC Omega=J sigma_(-i/2)(C^*)JY Omega and ||YC Omega||<=||sigma_(i/2)(C)|| ||Y Omega||. If the physical Arveson spectrum of C lies in [-S,S], then ||sigma_(i/2)(C)||<=exp(beta hbar S/2)||C||.
selected_tangent_raw_word_completion.recursive_smoothing: For a fixed word A_1...A_m, replace factors from right to left. If Y_j=A_j-C_j is the Fejer residual and the already smoothed right context has bandwidth S_j=sum_(k>j)R_k, the j-th telescoping error is at most exp(beta hbar S_j/2) epsilon_j(R_j), where epsilon_j(R)=||xi_j||[2/R^2+beta hbar/R]^(1/2)/(beta chi)^(1/2). Choose R_m first and then R_(m-1),...,R_1 after each finite right bandwidth is fixed. The total error tends to zero for every fixed finite word.
selected_tangent_raw_word_completion.conclusion: Every fixed finite raw configuration-orbit word moment and Gram entry converges along the selected tangent net. Independent limiting pivots therefore give pointed finite-core Fell/GNS convergence on the algebraic raw orbit-word span and identify its cyclic subspace in a GNS ultraproduct.
selected_tangent_raw_word_completion.scope: The bandwidths may grow rapidly with word length. No uniform word-length completion, arbitrary bounded-context multiplier theorem, common-Hilbert operator strong-star convergence, or all-exhaustion uniqueness follows.

zero_source_universal_orbit_smear_carrie.labels: Let Xi_Q be the finite-support rational configuration labels xi on Z^3 times {1,...,8}. For every periodic volume Lambda, periodize xi and write W_(Lambda,xi)=exp(i xi.q). Only the exact zero-source Hamiltonians H_Lambda(0) are used.
zero_source_universal_orbit_smear_carrie.generators: For f in L1(R), introduce a symbol A_(xi,f), linear in f with A_(xi,f)^*=A_(-xi,bar f). Its Lambda representation is the weak-operator integral pi_Lambda(A_(xi,f))=int f(t) tau_t^Lambda(W_(Lambda,xi))dt, so ||pi_Lambda(A_(xi,f))||<=||f||_1.
zero_source_universal_orbit_smear_carrie.completion: Take the supremum of the finite-volume representation norms on the unital formal star algebra, quotient its common kernel, and complete. The resulting separable C-star algebra A_H^0 is beta independent and state independent; the product of all pi_Lambda is faithful, while no individual quotient representation is required to be faithful.
zero_source_universal_orbit_smear_carrie.time_group: theta_s A_(xi,f)=A_(xi,tau_s f), (tau_s f)(t)=f(t-s). Equivariance makes theta_s isometric, L1 translation continuity makes it point-norm C0, and the smooth smear core has generator delta_H A_(xi,f)=-A_(xi,f').
zero_source_universal_orbit_smear_carrie.thermal_states: Every finite-volume Gibbs state pulled back through pi_Lambda is beta-KMS for theta. At each fixed beta, weak-star limits of such pullbacks remain beta-KMS. This statement does not identify the EXP-000800 phase envelopes as quotient representations of A_H^0.
zero_source_universal_orbit_smear_carrie.scope: Raw W_xi need not belong to A_H^0 because its finite Hamiltonian orbit is generally not norm continuous. The pi_Lambda are not an inductive system, temporal smears are dynamically delocalized, and A_H^0 has no proved spatial quasi-local net, all-exhaustion Cauchy property, momentum/CCR carrier, or polynomial delta_0 identification.

distinct_ground_doublets.input: Use the EXP-000789 zero-source periodic doublets Psi_L^plus/minus. Put K_L=H_L(0)-E_(0,L)>=0, V=L^3 and m_L^2=<S_L^2>/V^2. Eventually m_L>=m_0=sqrt(rho_*/2), and their energy excess satisfies epsilon_L=<Psi_L^plus/minus,K_L Psi_L^plus/minus><=hbar^2/(4 chi V m_L^2)<=hbar^2/(2 chi V rho_*).
distinct_ground_doublets.fixed_order_witness: At one fixed site let X=sum_(e=1)^8 q_e=sqrt(8)Q. If M_(4,Q)=sup_(L,plus/minus)<|Q|^4><infinity, put M_3=(64M_(4,Q))^(3/4). Choose one fixed rational r>0 with r^2 M_3<=3sqrt(8)m_0 and xi=r(1,...,1). Since |sin z-z|<=|z|^3/6 and parity exchanges the doublets, omega_L^plus(sin(rX))>=d and omega_L^minus(sin(rX))<=-d for all large L, where d=r sqrt(8)m_0/2>0.
distinct_ground_doublets.fixed_smear_witness: Choose one fixed T>0 and f_T(t)=T^(-1)(1-|t|/T)_+, whose integral is one and whose |t|^(1/2) moment is 8sqrt(T)/15. The single self-adjoint abstract observable b=[A_(xi,f_T)-A_(-xi,f_T)]/(2i) belongs to A_H^0 for every volume.
distinct_ground_doublets.smear_error: For every contraction B, |omega_L^plus/minus(tau_t(B))-omega_L^plus/minus(B)|<=2[2|t|epsilon_L/hbar]^(1/2). Hence the f_T-smear error is at most (16/15)[2T epsilon_L/hbar]^(1/2)<=(16/15)[hbar T/(chi V rho_*)]^(1/2), which tends to zero. Thus eventually omega_L^plus(b)>=d/2 and omega_L^minus(b)<=-d/2.
distinct_ground_doublets.ground_criterion: If a in A_H^0 has theta-Arveson spectrum in (-infinity,-nu] with nu>0 in inverse-time units, equivariance gives pi_Lambda(a)P_[0,hbar nu)(K_L)=0. Therefore omega_L^plus/minus(a^*a)<=||a||_H^2 epsilon_L/(hbar nu). Every joint weak-star cluster pair is consequently a pair of theta-ground states, and the fixed b separates the two states.
distinct_ground_doublets.scope: These are distinct algebraic ground states of the universal zero-source orbit-smear carrier. This is not yet a ground-state theorem on the sought quasi-local raw oscillator algebra and proves neither a positive broken-sector GNS gap nor a physical mass gap.

categorical_boundary.finite_matrix_fixture: The exact pair (beta_1,H_1)=(1,-sigma_x), (beta_2,H_2)=(2,-2sigma_x) with common configuration label sigma_z has orbit frequencies 2 and 4. Its L1 orbit smears generate M_2 direct-sum M_2 and carry one abstract C0 shift with both KMS pullbacks, although the labelled Hamiltonian generators differ nonscalarly.
categorical_boundary.consequence: A universal orbit-smear carrier can package inequivalent quotient dynamics. Its existence, KMS pullbacks and scoped ground states do not imply a quasi-local thermodynamic Hamiltonian limit, exhaustion uniqueness or canonical raw local generator. This retains the registered posthoc-direct-sum and automatic-cross-beta-gluing boundaries rather than overturning them.

projected_corridor_route_audit.bounded_cutoff: For pair interactions of norm at most J_L on a degree-z graph, a conservative pairwise-union cutoff estimate is 8sqrt(2)|X|||A||exp(nu_LT)(nu_LT)^R/R!, where nu_L=4zJ_L/hbar. The coordinate cutoff has J_L<=4cL^2 and z=6, hence nu_L<=96cL^2/hbar. Taking L=R^alpha makes this term vanish on compact time intervals for every 0<alpha<1/2.
projected_corridor_route_audit.static_tail_no_go: An exact four-dimensional matrix fixture has uniform all-a Gaussian coordinate moments, a q-only bond tail X with ||X||_D tending to zero and [log rho,X]=0, but ||[X,tau_T^K(W)]||_D^2 tends to 2 and the full-versus-cutoff orbit two-sided distance tends to 2. Thus static tail and first modular-derivative smallness alone do not imply projected orbit locality.
projected_corridor_route_audit.scope: The fixture is not a Q3LOCK counterexample because its state is not Gibbs invariant for the displayed Hamiltonians. It rejects only the logical inference from static tails/local normality to the missing connected two-orientation dynamic tail estimate.
